purpose: isolate the incremental effect of task-specific Procedure content without retrieval errors or Top-3 Skill interference
reuse_disclosure: This mechanism pilot reuses the six v12 cases and is not an independent performance confirmation.

condition_definitions.oracle_v3_full: load the complete manually assigned gold v3 Skill
condition_definitions.oracle_v3_metadata: load only Name, Description, and Activation Condition from the same gold v3 Skill
condition_definitions.oracle_v3_placebo: keep the same gold Skill metadata and replace Procedure and Termination Condition with task-irrelevant generic words matched to the original whitespace word count

decision_rule: Use this run only to validate the controlled prompts and directional signal. Freeze a larger targeted experiment only after the pilot passes.
